description: Call this after a compatibility check, purchase plan, verify_page or verify_mcp result that someone will rely on later (an order next week, an install, a resale, the next agent in a handoff). For product decisions we watch the records, manufacturer sources and US recall notices behind it; for page and MCP checks we re-run the same checks daily. Watches last 30 days and need only the receipt_id. Free during early access.

receipt_id.description: The receipt id (rcpt_...) that came with a check_compatibility or validate_purchase_plan answer.
